reuse.why: Uses the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked and findOrCreateBank, and routes Fintegra through newly extracted linkExternalAccount/saveLinkedAccount and a generalised downloadFileScopedTransactions shared with existing providers; the Akahu/EnableBanking download copies stay.

duplication.why: Rather than adding another copy of the link and download code, it collapses the existing per-provider copies; some pre-existing download duplication remains.

placement.why: Link logic in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and types in types/models, following the tree's layout.

scope.why: Refactors the GoCardless, SimpleFin, PluggyAi, Akahu and EnableBanking link paths, widens DbAccount's sync-source type and edits desktop-client files, well beyond a server-side provider addition.

maintainability.why: Shared link/save paths are easier to own; per-provider differences (bank key, fileId, sync-event tables) are explicit arguments, though the boolean/tables option bag is a little ad hoc.
